gen-eater-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-next: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next gives its lowercase big, generous eyes. Eater is at its best dark and widely spaced with short ascenders, while the sans does best keeping its rounds open.
gen-eater-gf-biryani: Eater's thin strokes have no hairlines at all, just dark, widely spaced letters with stubby ascenders. And the sharpest quality here is how Biryani draws every line without any swelling or thinning.
gen-eater-gf-blinker: Blinker holds its lines at a hefty thickness beneath Eater's dark, gappy display letters. Blinker's open apertures and tall-bodied lowercase keep a sans-serif paragraph moving, line after line.
gen-eater-gf-carrois-gothic: Dark, aggressive Eater runs wide-spaced, with horizontals a notch lighter than the uprights. Carrois Gothic is the sans that makes it work, its generous c opening and high x-height keeping things clear.
gen-eater-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Dark and gappy: Eater shifts weight moderately along each stroke. Carrois Gothic SC then reads smoothly, its curves open at every end and its capitals nearly level with the lowercase.
gen-eater-gf-chivo: Eater has the mild stroke variation of a letterpress slug. Chivo, the sans underneath, packs its lowercase up toward the caps and keeps every curve open, so paragraphs read with daylight.
gen-eater-gf-chocolate-classical-sans: Broad-nibbed strokes that never curl shut keep this body sizable and open. Chocolate Classical Sans does the quiet, steady reading, while Eater handles the dark, pinched-curve drama up top.
gen-eater-gf-comme: Dark and gappy, Eater shows hairline-free thin strokes beside moderately weighty stems, with ascenders kept short. Comme reads smoothly, its curves never clogged and its lowercase filling the height.
gen-eater-gf-cossette-texte: Eater arrives with gentle stroke variation, widely spaced letters and short ascenders. And Cossette Texte, with no stress in its curves, reads steadily thanks to a prominent x-height.
gen-eater-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans reads wide and open on small letters, its bodies dominating the line while ascenders hardly show. But the best thing here is Eater's sturdy hairlines giving it real bite.
